name: Prednisone
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

key_interactions.effect: Usually reduced warfarin response, sometimes the opposite (label).

key_interactions.action: Antidiabetic dose changes may be needed.
The corticosteroid dose may need to be increased.

key_interactions.effect: Corticosteroid metabolism down by up to 60%; more side effects (label).
Higher activity of both drugs; convulsions reported (label).
More gastrointestinal side effects; salicylate toxicity risk when the corticosteroid is withdrawn (label).
Weaker antibody response; live vaccine organisms may replicate (label).
key_interactions.action: Defer vaccination until corticosteroid therapy ends, if possible.
